evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label, refactors ECC_Context lifecycle management, and bridges core SHA256 hardware acceleration into libsecp256k1.
rationale: Plugging hardware-optimized SHA256 into libsecp256k1 contexts provides measurable cryptographic speedups without changing external interfaces. Benchmarks confirm ECDSA signing gets ~13–15% faster and Schnorr signing ~3–7% faster on CPUs with SHA extensions.
